title: Payment Flow — Stripe + Crypto
purpose: End-to-end payment processing covering Stripe tip/PPV unlock flow and crypto subscription flow via USDC on Base network
description: Dual payment flow: (1) Stripe path — frontend shows payment form, creates PaymentMethod via Stripe.js, backend creates PaymentIntent with confirm:true, handles 3D Secure/SCA if required, marks transaction completed; (2) Crypto path — fan connects MetaMask wallet, approves USDC spend, signs contract.paySubscription() which splits platform fee and creator amount via transferFrom, emits SubscriptionPaid event, backend verifies by calling eth_getTransactionReceipt and creates DB transaction+subscription records

validationRules.rule: blockchain_tx_hash must be unique in transactions table
Amount tolerance of 1 cent between on-chain and expected
Multer file size limit 1GB for uploads
MIME type filter for payment-related uploads

businessRules.rule: Platform fee is 12.5% (DEFAULT_COMMISSION_RATE) rounded via Math.round(amount * 12.5 / 100)
Sandbox bypass (0x0000 prefix) must be gated by NODE_ENV !== 'production'
Stripe endpoints for tip and unlock-post are dead (return 404)

securityConsiderations: Sandbox bypass 0x0000 prefix allows any authenticated user to create verified transactions without on-chain proof — critical vulnerability if deployed to production without NODE_ENV gate
Hardcoded placeholder contract addresses would cause verification against non-existent contracts in production
No rate limiting on /verify endpoint — potential RPC spam attack
Frontend uses raw fetch() for crypto endpoints, bypassing apiClient auth interceptors
JWT stored in localStorage — XSS attack surface
No CSRF protection on payment endpoints
performanceConsiderations: Blockchain RPC calls may take 2-10 seconds per verification
No caching layer — every payment verification hits blockchain and database
Synchronous processing blocks request thread during verification

annotations.text: Frontend wallet hook (useCryptoWallet.ts) is fully mocked — returns hardcoded addresses and fake 1250 USDC balance
Sandbox bypass: txHash starting with 0x0000 skips all on-chain verification — any authenticated user can create fake transactions
stripe_subscription_id column repurposed to store crypto txHash — semantic column misuse
